slides.title: The S08 work contract
slides.body: Full P01 and all required P03 parts belong to your individual work. P02 remains optional and its absence does not cap your mark.
slides.action: Record your actual package, date and environment. Keep pending work explicit.

slides.title: Evidence has a class
slides.body: SOURCE_REASONING, MODEL, REACT_TEST and REACT_BROWSER describe different checks. Saved PDF and Moodle receipt describe later actions.
slides.action: Write your prediction before the action. An unavailable runtime leaves an execution block.

slides.title: One complete array, several views
slides.body: The complete item array owns the data. The active filter changes the visible view. Counts and empty states follow from rendering.
slides.action: Name one prop passed down and one event intent passed up.

slides.title: The common fixture
slides.body: HTTP has ID a and is unread. SQLite has ID b and is read. Use valid plain-text titles and the same initial data.
slides.action: Record the route and storage namespace. The common comparator is /vanilla.html.

slides.title: The assessed P01 boundary
slides.body: Edit only projects/p01/student/src/App.jsx. Preserve entry points, CSS, helpers, fixtures, tests, package files and lockfiles.
slides.action: The 18-minute interval is progress towards full P01. The source estimate is 55–65 minutes and has not been measured.

slides.title: Responsibilities in P01
slides.body: QueueForm, QueueFilter, QueueList and QueueItem need explicit props and callbacks. Implement controlled input, immutable transitions and derived views.
slides.action: Trim and reject blank input before allocating an ID. Allocate the ID in the event before a pure updater.

slides.title: One transition witness
slides.body: Record the exact input, previous state, next complete array and visible counts for one add, toggle or remove action.
slides.action: Keep expected and observed separate. Include the actual action or command and a locator.

slides.title: The filter prediction
slides.body: After the named mount has completed, changing only the active filter should change visible items without changing the complete stored array or adding a persistence write.
slides.action: Name mount and StrictMode conditions. Restore any temporary diagnostic dependency edit.

slides.title: Identity after reload
slides.body: Shape validity and ID uniqueness answer different questions. The original entry counter can collide after reset. The separate preview has bounded ID reservation.
slides.action: Record add, persist, reload and add only if you really performed them. Name the launcher and the remaining limit.

slides.title: One actual bounded Gemini claim
slides.body: Use one sanitised excerpt about P01 or P03. Ask for a failure condition and an independent check. Keep the relevant actual prompt and answer extract.
slides.action: Keep secrets and institutional data out. The synthetic example and seeded component do not prove an actual conversation.

slides.title: Your independent verdict
slides.body: Check the returned claim against a contract, source and a named witness. Record method, result and locator.
slides.action: Choose ACCEPTED, REJECTED, PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED or UNKNOWN. Give a correction and a limit.

slides.title: The required P03 handoff
slides.body: Predict and diagnose before patching. Full P03 continues after the meeting. Edit only projects/p03/student/src/SearchPanel.jsx.
slides.action: P03 has eight required parts. P02 is optional. The P03 source estimate is 45–60 minutes and has not been measured.

slides.title: Permission to publish
slides.body: Trace A starts, A cleanup, B starts, B settles and A settles despite abort. A non-cooperative fake can settle old work after abortion.
slides.action: Separate timer cancellation, signal abortion and the guard that permits a state update.

slides.title: Three diagnostic guard variants
slides.body: A retains guards. B removes numeric comparisons while active/disposed remains. C keeps abort only and removes publication guards.
slides.action: Variant B may still reject old work. Record your actual guard conditions and restore the valid assessed file.

slides.title: An honest portable draft
slides.body: Use the 55-field form and save your own draft. Record unfinished P01, P03 and actual bounded review. Renew declaration after changing evidence.
slides.action: Exit ticket: one data owner, one falsifying observation and one qualification gate still open.

slides.title: One PDF, one Assignment
slides.body: Use TW2026_S08_GROUP_Surname_Firstname.pdf. Complete the preflight checklist and review the real saved PDF. Check Moodle status separately after upload.
slides.action: The teacher sets the deadline later. STOP if the later submission status is Draft.

slides.title: STOP at sixty
slides.body: Content work ends now. Preserve your draft and pending actions. The remaining 30 scheduled minutes serve logistics.
slides.action: Finish full P01, all required P03 parts and the bounded actual review before the configured deadline.
